description: Mediation Boards Commission - Notice calling for Nominations  for the Appointment of Mediaters for Kurunegala Adminstrative Districts
categorisation: This gazette notice is issued by the Mediation Boards Commission and concerns the appointment of mediators (Chairman and Mediators) for a Special Mediation Board. The primary focus is on the judicial/administrative process of appointing individuals to a quasi-judicial body responsible for resolving land disputes for a specific category of citizens. It details the nomination process, eligibility criteria, and the authority making the appointments. This falls under the "Judicial/Law Enforcement" category (Type 9) as it pertains to the appointment of officials for a dispute resolution body established by law.
